svg.title: Forty-eight GRPO steps on a GB10
svg.desc: Raw reward and the share of samples cut at the 1,024-token limit for each of 48 plain GRPO steps of Miles with Qwen3-0.6B on GSM8K on one NVIDIA GB10 with the default seed. The mean reward of the first 8 steps is 0.636 and of the last 8 is 0.758. The cut share falls from a mean of 0.33 to 0.08 over the same steps. Dashed lines show the raw rewards of runs with seeds 2 and 3, which rise from means of 0.653 to 0.736 and 0.614 to 0.766.
svg.text: share of samples cut at 1,024 tokens
